$comment: Benchmark-side mirror of the v0 read-tool contract in the overhaul plan (section 1, kept outside the repo). Replace with contracts/tools.v1.json once piece C lands it.

get_day_context.description: Events, scheduled tasks, task blocks, external busy times and free ranges for one local day.

list_active_projects.description: Plans that are not archived or done, with milestone summaries. Plans still in planning are included only when includePlanning is true.

get_project_context.description: One plan with its milestones, workstreams and tasks.

search_tasks.description: Tasks matching a text query and filters.

get_capacity.description: Working, busy, available and planned minutes for each day of a week.

get_recent_actions.description: Recently applied proposals and failures. Empty until agent storage lands.

get_memory.description: Remembered decisions, project facts and preferences, ranked by match to the query, then confirmed before unconfirmed, then newest. Superseded and expired memories are never returned. Mirrors get_memory in contracts/tools.v1.json.
